metadata.title: Centro Histórico de Salvador — blockout v1

projected.source: Deterministic projection of the WGS84 origin coordinate to WGS 84 / UTM zone 24S (EPSG:32724)

metadata.notes: Positions are local metres. For box-like blockouts, position is the mesh center. Only dimensions explicitly supported by a cited source are non-estimated; blockout values are never official measurements. The runtime now prefers versioned geospatial-derived OSM vectors and CONDER terrain. Procedural profiles, estimated plateaus/cutouts and manually curated fallback geometry are development fallbacks only and do not overwrite the persistent terrain when it is active. Palácio Thomé de Souza uses OSM way 1317127245 as the canonical horizontal footprint by documented geometric correlation with the IPHAN TPTS envelope; unsupported vertical dimensions remain estimated. Manual/extrapolated road ribbons and generic Rua Chile blocks were removed; road placement must come from versioned geospatial geometry, with live sources limited to refresh/diagnostic fallback.

lowerCity.source: Local datum chosen at lower elevator access

upperCity.source: IPHAN historical description: Cidade Alta approximately 65 m above the port; local blockout datum, not a surveyed point elevation

terrain.source: Procedural fallback profiles retained only for development recovery. Normal runtime terrain is the versioned geospatial-derived grid from CONDER Cartografia Sistemática 1992 REL_Curva_Nivel_L. Source elevations remain on the 2.5 m persistent grid; runtime presentation interpolates that authoritative surface at 1.25 m render spacing for smoother third-person geometry and normals. PBR macro/detail texturing changes appearance only, not GIS elevations.

cutouts.source: Procedural-terrain recovery snapshot of OpenStreetMap way 59224731, synchronized exactly with the current versioned derived footprint; normal runtime uses the canonical OSM footprint and persistent CONDER terrain.

plateaus.source: IPHAN Anexo XXIII documents the TPTS as fully occupied by a semi-underground level with an upper slab; horizontal envelope is official/derived, elevation 65.2 m is the current local blockout plaza datum and remains estimated.
